products.name: Colossyan
products.note: AI video avatars; enterprise training; consent management; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Colossyan is an AI platform designed for workplace training and enablement content. The company describes itself as turning existing documents, presentations, briefs, and raw expertise into structured video courses, with AI agents drafting full courses or individual videos from uploaded materials. Users edit and approve each scene before publishing, and the platform handles course structure, interactivity, localization, and delivery without requiring separate authoring or translation tools.

The core product, Colossyan Creator, centers on AI video generation using a library of over 300 AI avatars and voiceovers. The platform supports video and course creation from PDFs and presentations, interactive elements such as branching scenarios and quizzes, multi-language localization into more than 100 languages, team collaboration, versioning without re-recording, and SCORM export for learning management system delivery. Held facts note that the product is categorized under video generation and editing, with enterprise training, consent management, and UK-hosted infrastructure as notable attributes.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
